headline: A law renames the Postal Service facility at 15 South Valdosta Road in Lakeland, Georgia, as the Nell Patten Roquemore Post Office.
what_it_does: This act gives a specific U.S. Postal Service building in Lakeland, Georgia, a new official name honoring Nell Patten Roquemore. It changes only the name of the facility. It does not change mail service, postal rules, or how the building operates.
when_it_takes_effect: Enacted January 2, 2025, when it became law.
